title: Concept: npm audit disabled in the client configuration
description: .npmrc declares an `audit=false` npm client setting, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `audit=false` npm client setting.
